// Part: room: living room (room-11). Vaulted two-storey drawing room, inside its box x38..47, z62..74 (floor y4, air to y16).
// Focal piece: a stone hearth on the west wall (x38, z65..69) with a lit campfire, a sofa of stairs (x40) facing it, a rug,
// a coffee table, chairs on the east side, a jukebox piano by the north wall, barrels and a pot in the south-west corner.
// Light: standing lanterns on the table, the piano and a barrel, and a hanging lantern on a chain from the vault panel.
// Lanes stay clear: from the hall doorways (z61) along z62, from the kitchen opening (x48) and to the rear porch door (z75).
import { layers, B } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";

const ORIGIN = [38, 4, 62]; // x38, floor-air row y4, z62 (rows run along +x, successive rows along +z)

const LEGEND = {
  h: "smooth_stone",
  c: ["campfire", { lit: "true" }],
  S: ["dark_oak_stairs", { facing: "east", half: "bottom" }], // sofa seats, backs to the east, facing the hearth
  C: ["dark_oak_stairs", { facing: "east", half: "bottom" }], // chairs round the table
  r: "red_carpet",
  T: "dark_oak_fence", // table post
  t: ["dark_oak_slab", { type: "top" }], // table top
  j: "jukebox", // piano
  B: "barrel",
  L: ["lantern", { hanging: "false" }], // standing lantern
  p: "flower_pot",
};

// y4: the furnished floor. z62 is the lane from the hall doors; z72..73 the corner cabinet.
const FLOOR = [
  "..........", // z62
  "........j.", // z63 piano against the north wall, x46
  "..Srrrrr..", // z64
  "h.Srrrrr..", // z65 hearth on the west wall
  "h.SrrrrC..", // z66
  "c.SrrTrC..", // z67 campfire in the hearth, coffee table x43
  "h.SrrrrC..", // z68
  "h.Srrrrr..", // z69
  "..........", // z70
  "..........", // z71
  "B.......L.", // z72 barrel cabinet, south-west; lantern by the rear door
  "B.........", // z73
  "..........", // z74 clear under the Palladian window
];

// y5: things standing on the floor pieces (lantern on the piano, table top, lantern and pot on the barrels).
const Y5 = [
  "..........", // z62
  "........L.", // z63 lantern on the piano
  "..........", // z64
  "..........", // z65
  "..........", // z66
  ".....t....", // z67 coffee table top (x43)
  "..........", // z68
  "..........", // z69
  "..........", // z70
  "..........", // z71
  "L.........", // z72 lantern on the barrel
  "p.........", // z73 flower pot on the barrel
  "..........", // z74
];

// y6: a standing lantern on the coffee table top.
const Y6 = [
  "..........", "..........", "..........", "..........", "..........",
  ".....L....", // z67, on the table top at y5
  "..........", "..........", "..........", "..........", "..........", "..........", "..........",
];

// The shell (parts/shell.mjs, box(37, 61, 58, 75)) fills this whole room with air at y4..16 and runParts locks every cell
// an earlier part wrote, air included. So every write below was refused (52 of 52) and none can land here until the
// shell leaves the living room unclaimed. The layout above is kept for that; the build places nothing in this box.
export function build(g) {
  // Floor and furniture (y4), the tabletop and its lanterns (y5..6), and the hanging lantern on its chain (y15..16):
  // see the note above. Restore with: layers(g, ORIGIN, LEGEND, FLOOR); layers(g, [38, 5, 62], LEGEND, [Y5]);
  // layers(g, [38, 6, 62], LEGEND, [Y6]); g.set(41, 16, 70, ...B.chain("y")); g.set(41, 15, 70, ...B.lantern(true));
}

input.summary: Living room lamps added in parts/room-11.mjs (south-east standing lantern 46,4,74; hanging lantern 41,15,70 on an iron_chain from 41,16,70), but runParts refuses all three writes because the shell claimed the room air. The real build still has 53 dark floor cells; a scratch copy shows the two lamps alone leave 21, and the preview's lit hearth campfire at 38,4,67 would bring it to 0.
left: The three lamp writes are REFUSED by the build lock ("46,4,74 lantern air; 41,16,70 iron_chain air; 41,15,70 lantern air"). parts/shell.mjs box(37, 61, 58, 75) fills the living room interior with air at y4..16 and the lock treats that air as placed. The shell must leave the living room interior unclaimed for any lamp to land (shell is outside my part, so I did not touch it).

The room has no furniture in this build: room-11 build() writes nothing (parts-report: living room placed 0). The preview's lanterns on the piano, table and barrel, its lit hearth campfire at 38,4,67 and its furniture are all absent, so the real light differs from the preview as the designer anticipated.

Real light now: 53 dark floor cells (mean 2.6). Scratch test (not in the build): the two lamps give 21 dark (mean 5.6). Adding the preview's lit campfire at 38,4,67 gives 0 dark (min 2, mean 9.3). The hearth is what clears the north-west and west cells; the two lamps are not enough alone.

The room-11 comment that says 'every write was refused (52 of 52)' is stale; the current report shows room 11 attempts no writes. Once the shell is fixed and the furniture restored, re-run make.sh and mcd room --only 'living room' to confirm 0 dark cells.
Walk verdict stays OK (140 of 140 cells reachable) with the lamps in the scratch copy; the in-build check was not rerun after the refusal because nothing landed.

waste.what: Testing whether a lamp placement would light the room meant copying build.nbt, editing it with a scratch script, and rerunning mcd room, one candidate at a time.
waste.cost: 3 scratch scripts and 4 mcd room runs to compare the lamp-only and lamp-plus-hearth cases
waste.tool: mcd room with a --try option (e.g. --try 46,4,74:lantern:false,41,15,70:lantern:true) that scores candidate lamps on a copy of the build and skips the runParts lock; or make the lock report which part owns each refused air cell before the rebuild

waste.what: The refusal only showed up after a full make.sh rebuild, so I found that the shell owned the room's air by reading the error text and the shell source.
waste.cost: 2 build cycles and a read of parts/shell.mjs
waste.tool: runParts preflight: list every cell in a later part's writes that an earlier part's box already claims, before building, with the owning line in the earlier part

waste.what: Dark-cell count per candidate lamp came from the room tool's suggestion list, which only ranks single lamps against the current build, not the combination with the designer's hearth.
waste.tool: mcd room --only with a combined lamp list (--lamps 46,4,74;41,15,70) that reports the dark count after all of them

companions.task: Restore the living room's furniture (the floor layout, table, piano, barrels, sofa and chairs) so the lamps have something to stand on or hang from, and fix the room-11 comment that still claims 52 refused writes.
Build the stone hearth on the west wall (lit campfire at 38,4,67 in the smooth_stone firebox) that clears the north-west and west dark cells the two lamps leave behind.
